title: Haltedness Under Embedding
statement: For any finite-tape Turing machine configuration $c$, its embedded oracle-machine configuration has no current state if and only if $c$ has no current state.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration with $k$ work tapes over a symbol alphabet and state set
replaced:
A configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes is halted if and only if its
embedding into the $(k+1)$-tape oracle model is halted.
